answer.explanation: The visible log events show no errors, timeouts, throttles or AccessDenied messages. Durations are stable across all four functions (CrudApi about 25-40 ms, Uploader about 80-240 ms, Thumbnailer about 100-200 ms, Compression about 500-640 ms), and Max Memory Used stays well below each configured size (for example 95 MB of 256 MB, and 102 MB of 1024 MB for Compression). The Compression function is over-provisioned at 1024 MB, which is a cost concern rather than a configuration anomaly. 4223 events were truncated, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
